description.value:
As part of the action to cast this power, you make a melee weapon attack against a target within your reach, and the power fails if you don't. On a hit, the attack deals its normal damage, and you begin emitting an unsettling hum. Any hostile creature that ends its turn within 5 feet of you before the start of your next turn takes 1d4 sonic damage.

At 5th level the melee attack deals an extra 1d8 sonic damage, and the hum's damage increases by 1d4; both bonuses grow again by 1d8 and 1d4, respectively, at 11th and 17th level.

system.source: PHB Ch.14 Casting — Tech Powers, At-Will
